issues.detail: The Greek text contains the word 'ενεδιδυσκετο' (he was clothed/dressed), which is missing in the Vietnamese translation. The Vietnamese implies he is wearing them, but misses the specific verb of being clothed.
The Greek 'ευφραινομενος' means 'rejoicing/gladdening', whereas 'vui chơi xa hoa' (playing luxuriously) adds a concept of 'playing' (vui chơi) that is not present in the Greek.
